properties.description: Production delta/incremental synchronization pipeline using Microsoft Graph API delta query. Handles pagination via Until loop with @odata.nextLink, refreshes OAuth2 token every 45 minutes, persists deltaLink for true incremental sync, and processes libraries sequentially to avoid variable scoping conflicts.

activities.name: Get_ClientSecret
activities.description: Retrieve Service Principal client secret from Key Vault

activities.name: Get_AccessToken
activities.description: Acquire OAuth2 token for Microsoft Graph API

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT mc.Id, mc.SiteUrl, mc.LibraryName, ISNULL(iw.LastModifiedDate, '1900-01-01') AS LastModifiedDate, ISNULL(iw.LastSyncTime, '1900-01-01') AS LastSyncTime, iw.DeltaLink, iw.DriveId FROM dbo.MigrationControl mc LEFT JOIN dbo.IncrementalWatermark iw ON mc.SiteUrl = iw.SiteUrl AND mc.LibraryName = iw.LibraryName WHERE mc.Status = 'Completed' AND mc.EnableIncrementalSync = 1

datasetSettings.description: Dataset for the migration control table containing SharePoint sites and libraries to migrate with status tracking.

activities.name: Get_Drive
activities.description: Resolve SharePoint site to Graph drive ID (skip if DriveId already stored)

activities.name: Set_InitialDeltaUrl
activities.description: Use stored deltaLink if available, otherwise start fresh delta query

activities.name: Set_HasMorePages_True
activities.description: Reset pagination flag for this library

activities.name: Until_AllDeltaPagesProcessed
activities.description: Paginate through all delta pages for this library

activities.name: Refresh_ClientSecret
activities.description: Retrieve fresh client secret from Key Vault each iteration

activities.name: Refresh_AccessToken
activities.description: Acquire OAuth2 token (AAD returns cached token if still valid)

activities.name: Get_DeltaPage
activities.description: Fetch current page of delta results from Graph API

activities.name: Filter_DeltaFiles
activities.description: Filter delta page to only file items (exclude folders and deleted items)

activities.name: Execute_CopyFileBatch
activities.description: Delegate file copying to child pipeline (works around ADF restriction on ForEach inside Until)

activities.name: Set_HasMorePages
activities.description: Set pagination flag based on presence of @odata.nextLink

activities.name: Set_CurrentPageUrl_Next
activities.description: Update page URL to nextLink if present

activities.name: Set_DeltaLink
activities.description: Capture deltaLink from last page for next incremental sync

activities.name: Wait_ThrottleDelay
activities.description: Wait between pages to avoid Graph API throttling
